our_interpretation: The plain reading is that publishers and commercial sites already produced substantial amounts of low-value material expressly to attract Google search traffic.
The scope is the commercial content-production ecosystem described in the surrounding paragraphs, rather than all internet content.
Low value means repetitive, padded, or derivative material offering little useful information beyond its search-ranking purpose.
The statement that AI might spread the material is a possibility, not an antecedent that must occur before the historical claim can be assessed.
Use June 2023 through publication as the latest contemporaneous reporting window for the ongoing practice; no formal reporting period is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary investigations document recurring, scaled production of low-value content designed to obtain Google traffic, including evidence of producers’ methods or intentions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence shows that the described production was exceptional, or that the allegedly low-value material principally served substantive reader needs rather than search-traffic acquisition.
